name: iron-asylum-heroku
description: The root of the tree scripts/heroku.sh deploys: the repo's layout (backend/, and frontends/ without the app), so the server finds the frontends' builds where it does in a checkout. Heroku builds the website, the admin and the server, then runs the server.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontends --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix frontends && rm -rf frontends/node_modules frontends/.angular && npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix backend && npm prune --prefix backend --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
